summary: Ternium S.A. filed a Form 6-K summarizing resolutions adopted at its Annual General Meeting held May 12, 2026. The meeting covered routine items: approval of annual accounts, allocation of results including a final dividend of USD 0.13 per share (USD 1.30 per ADS) payable May 15, 2026, discharge of board members, reappointment of eight directors, and authorization of director compensation. This is a routine shareholder meeting report with no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or restructuring. No deal terms are present.
